# Megan’s Macaw Aviary

> Macaw adoption in Raleigh, North Carolina. Hand-raised, socialized macaws raised in a home environment: blue-and-gold, green-winged, military, hyacinth and scarlet macaws. Visits are by appointment. Contact by phone or text at +1 805-259-3980.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://megansmacawsaviary.vercel.app/): Overview of the aviary and how to get started.
- [Available macaws](https://megansmacawsaviary.vercel.app/available): Birds listed as available, reserved or sold.
- [Learn](https://megansmacawsaviary.vercel.app/learn): Whether a macaw is right for you, species guide, care and health, how adoption works, and common questions.
- [Contact](https://megansmacawsaviary.vercel.app/contact): Call, text or message Megan.
